senses.gloss: (cmp. טרד), Hif. הִתְרִיז to squirt, splash; to have diarrhœa, commit a nuisance.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 38a:6">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>במַתְרֶזֶת</he> when the animal discharges with a splash, opp. <he>בשותתת</he>, v. <cite ref="U02140"><he>שָׁתַת</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 47b">B. Kam. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>אכל חטין וה׳ ומת</he> the animal ate wheat, and got diarrhœa and died; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 90a:12">B. Mets. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>היתה אוכלת ומתרזת</he>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 53b">Succ. 53ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 77a:1">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> <he>ומַתְרִיזִין</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01943"><he>פָּרַע</he></cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 72b:7">Kidd. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>ומתריזין עצמם</he> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: to be shocked, frightened; to be seized with a panic.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Lev. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ונִתְרָזִין מתוך וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01203"><he>פַּנִּיקְטִין</he></cite>; Tanḥ. T’rum. 9 <he>ונתרזין בתוך אהליהם</he> (not <he>לתוך</he>) and be panic-stricken in their camps.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1">Ib.</cite> <he>והן נתרזין</he> and they were frightened.
